# TASK-151 — specification

## Scope

Skill audit: one pure module (`shared/skill-audit.ts`) checks a skill against Anthropic's authoring guide (name and description rules, body under 500 lines, references one level deep and reachable, contents list on reference files over 100 lines, third-person description that says what and when, checklist and feedback loop for multi-step skills, no volatile dates, no Windows paths); `pnpm skills:check` runs it on this repository's skills and a generated skill, and CI runs it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Make those rules checkable instead of remembered. `shared/skill-audit.ts` returns findings with a severity (errors fail `pnpm skills:check`, CI and the tests; warnings are advice).
- [x] It applies to this repository's skills and to every skill SDD Studio generates.
- [x] Testing on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus and writing three evaluations per skill are not automatable here and stay in the backlog.

## Verification

- tests/skill-audit.test.ts
- pnpm skills:check --strict

## Notes

Tests: `tests/skill-audit.test.ts` (28). `pnpm skills:check --strict` passes; pointed at third-party skills it finds real problems. The CI step has not run on GitHub.
